title: The PublishPress Tag Groups: Stylish Displays For Your Tags and Categories plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The PublishPress Tag Groups plugin for WordPress up to version 3.0.0 is vulnerable to stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) via the 'separator' parameter. Authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute when other users view the affected pages. The vulnerability arises from improper sanitization and output escaping, specifically due to the plugin decoding HTML entities before rendering, which reactivates potentially harmful markup.
